title: Dual RTX 3060 12GB (layer-split) — realistic tok/s for Qwen3.8-27B?
body: Currently running a single RTX 3060 12GB, planning to pick up a second one specifically to run Qwen3.8-27B locally Planning to run --split-mode layer rather than tensor-split( the second card will be connected via a USB 3.0-style PCIe riser) I'd really appreciate real prefill/decode numbers — trying to set expectations before I buy the second card. Note: I really cannot afford a 3090 right now, or anytime in the near
